_doc: 1.5.0 (de-robotization slice 1, 2026-08-15) — the range boundaries are ramps
instead of steps. This pack was the roster's clearest machine signature: it
limped or called blocks 35% to 56% of the deck wide at weight 1.0, and
folded everything outside them at weight 0. Each of those blocks now plays
at 0.88-0.90 with an adjacent band of hands just outside it at 0.33-0.49, so
a marginal hand is sometimes played and sometimes not.
WIDTH IS HELD BY CONSTRUCTION, not by luck: each fringe band was sized so
the combo-weighted total it adds equals what shaving the core removes.
Measured after the edit, combo-weighted continue: unopened 46.74 -> 46.78,
vs_limpers 56.56 -> 56.53, vs_rfi 56.56 -> 56.30. The station still calls
far too much — that is the archetype and it is untouched. What changed is
that it no longer draws the same line in the same place every hand.
1.4.0 (de-robotization slice 1, 2026-08-15) — `vs_rfi` is answered per seat,
as a TWO-band split (blinds against everyone else) rather than the four
bands the regulars get. A recreational player does not reason about
position; what a station does notice is money already in the pot, so it
continues wider from the blinds (65.3%) than elsewhere (53.8%) and is
otherwise seat-blind. Its `vs_limpers` and `vs_3bet` nodes are deliberately
left position-blind: over-limping and calling down are exactly where this
archetype does not adjust, and fold-to-3-bet is this pack's single
strongest separating statistic. Table-realised vs_rfi continue held at
